constraints.name: ck_citas_estado_actual
constraints.definition: CHECK (((estado_actual)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RECIBIDA'::character varying, 'CONFIRMADA'::character varying, 'REPROGRAMADA'::character varying, 'CANCELADA'::character varying, 'LIBERADA'::character varying, 'ATENDIDA'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_citas_target_solo_con_desenlace
constraints.definition: CHECK (((target_no_show IS NULL) OR ((estado_actual)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ATENDIDA'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying])::text[]))))
